name: Uma Converter Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, UMA Converter Ltd manufactures customized plastic packaging material[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is a manufacturer and exporter of Flexible Packaging Material offering customized packaging solutions for various industries such as food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, and personal care. Apart from this, the company also manufactures and carries out various printing and lamination processes for third parties on a job-work basis.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.54 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.94% over last 3 years.
